sloka: एवमुक्तः सुमन्त्रेण राजवेश्मनि लक्ष्मणः ।प्रविश्य सीतामासाद्य व्याजहार नरर्षभः ।। ७.४६.६ ॥
transliteration: evamuktaḥ sumantreṇa rājaveśmani lakṣmaṇaḥ ।praviśya sītāmāsādya vyājahāra nararṣabhaḥ ।। 7.46.6 ॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, the best among men, thus addressed by Sumantra, entered the royal palace, approached Sita, and spoke to her.
